== Please don't remove references == 

 Though you may have some justification in your head that after an episode airs, references can be removed, your justification does not reflect WikiProject Television community editing standards. We need references in articles to be able to verify data. References are what make the project strong. The original airdate, for example, is not necessarily something you can observe when the episode airs. A title can be observed when the episode airs, the plot can be observed. Thus, these edits  are not constructive. When a vandal comes by and arbitrarily changes the dates, as happens all day long at Wikipedia, how do validate the change if there's no reference? Exactly.
